$comment: Products Sparkgeo runs that the asset register cannot name (the register lists cloud resources, not the software on them). One entry per product: `match` are case-insensitive substrings tested against the KEV vendorProject, product and vulnerability name and against advisory titles; `repos` are the repositories that deploy it (the trigger issue is opened there when a cross-repo token is configured, and their register records supply exposure and owners); `exposure` is the fallback when the register has no public record for those repos. Reviewed when a product is added or retired; the kev-trigger job summary lists new KEV entries that matched nothing. Issue #187.
